ground_truth_rule: expected_findings=1 iff the text as plainly read asserts that C0 and C2 are, or are to be treated as, one class/schema/family (a class-separation leak). expected_findings=0 iff it only negates, forbids, quotes, questions, labels or audits the composite, or asserts that the two classes are/stay separate.
